name: Marvel Fresh Start Avengers
description: The Final Host gathers Thor, Captain America, Iron Man and Black Panther into a new Avengers team for Marvel's Fresh Start. Jason Aaron's main title is read with Wakanda Forever, Kelly Thompson's West Coast Avengers and Gerry Duggan's Savage Avengers, through the World Tour, the War of the Vampires and No Road Home. Gaps in the main series are deliberate.
sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide
